meta.title: Template Creator — Build PDF templates with drag & drop
meta.description: Visual PDF template builder with drag & drop, dynamic data and one-click export.

hero.title: Build PDF templates by dragging and dropping
hero.subtitle: Template Creator is the visual editor for designing professional documents with headers, footers, tables and dynamic data — then exporting them as pixel-faithful PDFs without writing a single line of code.

features.title: Everything you need to produce documents
features.subtitle: From the first drag to the final PDF, all in one place.

items.title: Visual drag & drop
items.desc: Compose your document with paragraphs, tables, images, checkboxes and containers, and reorder them with a single drag.

items.title: Header, body and footer
items.desc: Three independent zones: global header and footer that repeat automatically on every page of the PDF.

items.title: Dynamic data with Handlebars
items.desc: Connect your JSON and use variables like {'{{'}client.name{'}'}{'}'} with autocomplete inside the editor.

items.title: Styling with Tailwind and CSS
items.desc: Apply Tailwind classes from the properties panel or write your own CSS live.

items.title: Faithful PDF export
items.desc: Chrome headless prints your design with background colors and letter size, ready to share or print.

items.title: Undo, redo and instant editing
items.desc: 50-step history, per-component properties panel and keyboard shortcuts.

screenshots.title: A look inside the editor
screenshots.subtitle: Design on the canvas, inspect the JSON schema, tune your styles and edit the sample data — all in the same tab.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people usually ask before getting started.

items.a: A visual PDF template builder: drag components in, connect your data, and export the final document as a PDF.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. You can design the whole document from the editor. If you want to go further, you can use Tailwind classes, custom CSS and Handlebars templates.

items.q: How does data reach the template?
items.a: Through a JSON payload injected with Handlebars on preview and export. Everything runs in your browser and on your server.

items.q: What size and format is the PDF?
items.a: It is generated with Chrome headless in letter size with background colors enabled, ideal for printing and emailing.

items.q: Can I try it without signing up?
items.a: Yes. The demo is open at /demo, no account and no time limit.
Yes: apply Tailwind classes from the properties panel, and write your own rules live in the CSS tab.
